purpose: Fifth follow-up register after implementing the PyFluent workflow on claude-mainline with offline dry-run and manifest-audit tests. This appends PyFluent closure evidence without rewriting prior registers.

items.closure_summary: PyFluent workflow support is now present on claude-mainline as an offline-testable adapter workflow plus CLI runner. Tests use FakeAdapter and --dry-run only, so no Fluent license is required for review.

Boundary updates are now validated against allowed_boundary_variables before adapter execution, so invalid zone/variable pairs fail during config validation instead of disappearing into setattr behavior.
FluentWorkflow.run writes a success=false manifest in the finally path before re-raising solver/adapter failures, and always closes the adapter.
run_pyfluent_workflow exposes a --dry-run mode that loads and validates config, emits JSON, and does not instantiate PyFluentAdapter.

PyFluent config and manifests require validation_chain fields for cad_source_sha256, material_card_path, and mesh_summary while preserving engineering_validated=false and production_release_allowed=false.

items.remaining_gap: PyFluent is now present locally, but the branch is still ahead of origin and final codex-review-line/claude-mainline integration remains a publish/branch-management step.
items.next_action: Publish or integrate the content-scoped commits through the branch_integration_strategy.md workflow.
